name: tortoise-orm-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Tortoise ORM, an asyncio object-relational mapper for Python.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in Tortoise ORM's core ORM layer: the `tortoise` package excluding the `tortoise/migrations`, `tortoise/cli` and `tortoise/contrib` subpackages and every database backend other than `tortoise/backends/base` and `tortoise/backends/sqlite`.
The documentation for that code is `README.rst`, the docstrings and comments in that code, and these guides under `docs/`: `connections.rst`, `databases.rst`, `direct_queries.rst`, `exceptions.rst`, `expressions.rst`, `fields.rst`, `functions.rst`, `getting_started.rst`, `indexes.rst`, `logging.rst`, `manager.rst`, `models.rst`, `query.rst`, `router.rst`, `schema.rst`, `setup.rst`, `signals.rst`, `timezone.rst`, `transactions.rst` and `validators.rst`.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the fi
